text:
maya (support): FYI, saw 3 similar asks this morning about per-tenant embedding quotas + burst limits (Acme, Boro, DataWave). All filed as separate support tickets.
lee (product): Can you paste the ticket links? I want to see differences before we consolidate. Do we have any customer-facing updates yet?
maya (support): links: <https://support.redwood.ai/t/3245>, <https://support.redwood.ai/t/3249>, <https://support.redwood.ai/t/3251>. No replies sent — requested product intake.
tony (sales): Acme is asking for a timeline. They mentioned a compliance audit — would be good to mark urgency.
lee (product): OK. Proposal: instead of leaving these as duplicates, create a canonical intake ticket that links the three, assign an "intake-owner" and a single PRD-lite row. Suggested tags: `linked_request`, `customer-impact:high/medium/low`, `requested-by:sales/support`.
lee (product): Also propose a small customer-facing status field we can surface in one-liners: `Received`, `Under review`, `Planned`, `Scheduled`, `Released`.
rachel (eng): For effort estimation I need a short scope: is this just rate-limiting config + UI toggle, or changes to shard/throughput? If it's per-tenant KV caching, that's more involved.
maya (support): From tickets: customers want hard quota per-tenant for embeddings and a burst allowance for short windows. Example: Acme wants 10M tokens/day + 1M burst. No req for cross-tenant isolation at infra level.
lee (product): Good. I'll create the canonical ticket and add a short scope section. Who should own comms back to these customers while we triage?
nina (customer-success): CS can send a holding note. Would like a small template we can use so messaging is consistent.
lee (product): Draft template below — please reuse and edit as needed:
```\nHi {{customer_name}},\nThanks for the request — we’ve consolidated your ask into our intake ticket (internal: #{canonical_id}).\nStatus: Under review.\nNext steps: Product is scoping and engineering will estimate work by MM/DD.\nIf you have priority constraints (audit dates, launch windows), reply with those and we’ll factor them in.\nThanks,\nCustomer Success / Redwood\n```
maya (support): perfect. I can send that to all three. Will include a note asking for any deadline dates.
tony (sales): For Acme — I can confirm audit window: mid-May. Please mark that on the canonical ticket as high urgency.
lee (product): Action items: 1) I’ll create canonical intake + link the three tickets and tag them. 2) @rachel can you give a quick estimate (T-shirt) by EOD tomorrow? 3) @nina/maya send holding note today.
rachel (eng): I’ll run a quick spike. If it’s just config + API gating, should be S (small). If we need backend multi-tenant routing changes, M-L. Will update by EOD tomorrow.
triage-bot: created linked intake #4287 and attached support tickets 3245, 3249, 3251 (automated).
lee (product): great — canonical id is #4287. I put `customer-impact:high` and `requested-by:support` on it.
maya (support): sending template now. Will paste thread IDs in the ticket comments so sales/CS can follow.
nina (customer-success): sent to Acme + Boro + DataWave. Used template and asked for priority dates. Acme replied: "audit May 15" — added to ticket.
lee (product): once @rachel posts estimate, I'll add tentative priority and schedule into the roadmap spreadsheet + ping infra if we need capacity for a dedicated pooling config.
tony (sales): thanks. If product decides timeline is >Q3, I need to know asap so I can manage renewal talks.
lee (product): noted. We'll surface timeline options in #roadmap-slate after the estimate. Thanks everyone — this linking flow seems to work. If anyone thinks we need a different tag or a new field on intake, call it out here.
rachel (eng): small ask: can we add `deadline_date` field to intake so automation can surface hard SLAs? Will follow up in the intake GH issue.
lee (product): good ask — add that to the ticket. marking owner: @lee (product), eng-assess: @rachel (eng), comms: @nina (customer-success) / @maya (support).
